blockingFindings.description: V77 makes the shorts longer in neutral standing, but sit and crouch still expose broad anterior thigh areas while the garment panels lift away from the legs.
Sit and crouch renders show sharp triangular overlapping panel/hem intersections at the side and apron transition; side and rear folds remain strongly corrugated.
The longer matched shorts and leveled apron trial do not produce a smooth, even standing skirt: side panels retain ribbed ridges and the front hem remains visibly irregular.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
